name: External Flink Job
description: Declare one or several Flink jobs on a self-hosted cluster as external assets in the Dagster asset graph (jobs: for several jobs sharing one sensor/overview call) -- makes them visible for lineage without materializing them from Dagster.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: Declares an externally-managed asset -- no Dagster materialization happens here.

jobmanager_url.description: Base URL of the Flink JobManager REST API, e.g. 'http://flink-jobmanager:8081'.
jobmanager_url.label: JobManager URL

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Dagster asset key for a single job. Mutually exclusive with `jobs:` -- use this (with `job_name:`) to declare exactly one job, or `jobs:` to declare several from one component instance sharing jobmanager_url and one observation sensor.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: The job's configured name, as reported by GET /jobs/overview. Mutually exclusive with `jobs:`.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps these external assets' status current. When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec(s).

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{job_name}__observation_sensor' in single-job mode. Required when using `jobs:`. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between status polls. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

request_headers.label: Request Headers
request_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for every poll, e.g. an Authorization header if the JobManager sits behind an authenticating proxy.

request_timeout_seconds.label: Request Timeout Seconds
request_timeout_seconds.description: HTTP request timeout for each poll.

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.
